seo.title: Borbone Pizzeria & Caffè JLT | Authentic Italian Pizza, Pasta & Coffee by the Lake
seo.description: Borbone Pizzeria & Caffè, Lake Level, Platinum Tower, Cluster I, JLT: authentic Italian pizza alla pala, spaghetti alla Nerano, parmigiana, sandwiches, croissants and fresh juices with a lake-view terrace. Open 7 AM to midnight. 4.9 from 543 reviews.

hero.kicker: Lake Level · Platinum Tower · Cluster I, JLT
hero.lede: Authentic Italian street food and caffè on the JLT lake: pizza alla pala, spaghetti alla Nerano, parmigiana, focaccia sandwiches and espresso from 7 AM until midnight.
